node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 coordinate K-fiber Vieta-rank compiler
node.closure: quotient-invariant five-edge coordinates and exact 10-row Vieta kernel gates in both coordinate parity spaces
node.statement: For a common-K quotient point [u:v] with source lift [r:s], the selected J-edge has deck-independent homogeneous coordinates p=ab and q=rs(a+b). The positive 8-parameter source form satisfies A_0=p A_2 and uv B_1=-q A_2; the negative 7-parameter form satisfies B_0=p B_2 and A_1=-q B_2. Across five fibers these are exact 10 x 8 and 10 x 7 kernel gates with leading support. The negative branch excludes ramified K values. Each branch has a five-by-five determinant obstruction, and the negative products have an additional rank-three gate. This is not an orientation deletion.
